name: finance-overview
description: Composes metrics and selectable transactions into an embeddable finance overview without owning navigation or state.
usage:
FinanceOverview(
    "Overview",
    balanceTitle: "Available balance",
    balance: Text(12_480.32, format: .currency(code: "USD")),
    changeTitle: "Monthly change",
    change: Text(0.082, format: .percent),
    sectionTitle: "Recent activity",
    transactions: [
        FinanceTransactionItem(
            id: "salary",
            title: Text("Salary"),
            subtitle: Text("Yesterday"),
            amount: Text(2_450, format: .currency(code: "KWD")),
            systemImage: "building.columns.fill",
            tone: .positive
        )
    ],
    onSelect: { id in }
)
accessibility: Uses native Button semantics for selectable transactions and ContentUnavailableView for an empty activity state; the screen and section titles carry the header trait, and Voice Control can address a row by its title alone.
Uses system text styles and ViewThatFits for Dynamic Type.
Uses leading and trailing alignment so layout follows right-to-left direction.
